commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+6' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Mark Flekken shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
90+5' Fabio Carvalho (Brentford) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post.
90+3' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

31' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Andre Onana thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
28' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) tries to find Sepp van den Berg, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
26' The corner kick from Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

25' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Mark Flekken pulls off a brilliant save.
24' A pass into the penalty area from Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) is intercepted by the defence.
24' Some patient build-up play from Manchester Utd as they look to unlock the defence.
21' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

20' There's an opportunity for Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

15' Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
14' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) is unable to get the free-kick over the defensive wall from mid-range.

2' A pass from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is intercepted by Mark Flekken and the move breaks down.
